remarks: Enjoy spectacular direct water views of Holly Pond from this bright and sunny 2-bedroom, 2-bath unit with a finished lower level. Conveniently located just around the corner from Cove Island Park and Beach, Chelsea Piers, and only minutes from the train station and downtown Stamford. The main level boasts an open floor plan with an eat-in kitchen featuring newer stainless-steel appliances and laminate floors, leading to a private brick and flagstone patio-perfect for entertaining, relaxing, or having a BBQ with friends and family. The bright and spacious living area with hardwood floors fully capitalizes on the stunning pond views. The expansive primary bedroom suite includes hardwood floors, a walk-in closet, and a full bath with a tub/shower. Another generously sized bedroom with built-ins and hardwood floors, along with a full bath equipped with a washer and dryer, complete this level. The finished lower level provides endless possibilities, ideal for a family room, home office, or in-law suite with an independent entrance and a full bath. Central air conditioning and a high-efficiency gas furnace complete the package. The property includes a detached 1-car garage and additional space for 2 more cars in the driveway. Landlord is responsible for snow removal and landscaping. Excellent credit and verifiable income are required. Schedule your private viewing before it's gone!
